text:
alex c: Spinning up a new org + accounts for Project Hera. Need a concise multi-cloud ops playbook for AWS/GCP/Azure account setup, GPU quota requests, networking, tags, and IAM. Who's got a checklist we can run with?

mira chen: I can sketch one out. High-level: billing linkage, org policies, tag schema, KMS, SSO groups, shared VPC design, per-region GPU quota requests, and guardrail SCPs/budgets.

jordan lee: + include exact quota types and a small template for requests. For reference: GCP (compute.googleapis.com -> GPUs: nvidia-t4, a100), AWS (EC2 GPU families p3/p4/g4), Azure (NC/ND series). Each provider wants region by region counts and projected steady-state + burst.

samir patel: Network notes: use host/shared VPC pattern (GCP) or Transit Gateway (AWS) so training/serving projects don't own default networks. Configure private egress (NAT gateway), flow logs, firewall baseline (deny all, allow necessary infra), and restrict public IPs on GPU nodes unless absolutely needed.

alex c: Can you paste a simple quota request template we can reuse for tickets? Want to include in the onboarding runbook.

jordan lee: Sure — drop this in the support case body: 
```
Project: project-hera-prod
Org ID: 123456789012
Billing account: BILL-ABCDEFG
Cloud provider: GCP / AWS / Azure
Regions: us-central1, us-west1
Machine/GPU type: n1-standard-32 + nvidia-a100 (or p4d.24xlarge for AWS)
Requested GPU count (per region): us-central1: 8 GPUs, us-west1: 4 GPUs
Start date: 2025-10-01
Justification: Production inference serving for Project Hera; expected 2000 qps across endpoints; steady-state 4k tokens/min; latency SLO 150ms.
Contact: mira.chen@redwood.ai, +1-xxx-yyy
```
Add estimated monthly vCPU/GPU hours and expected peak scale.

mira chen: IAM & org policy checklist (short):
- Create groups: org-admins, infra-operators, billing-owners, model-deployers
- Least-privilege roles for infra-operators (compute.instanceAdmin, storage.admin)
- Enforce resource labels via org policy: required labels: project, team, cost-center, env
- KMS keys in a central project with limited cryptoKeyEncrypter/Decrypter to infra group
Sample GCP binding: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding project-hera-prod --member=group:infra-operators@redwood.ai --role=roles/compute.instanceAdmin`

ops-bot: Reminder: open quota requests at least 72 hours before needed for GCP; Azure quota escalations can take 7-10 business days unless escalated through account rep.

samir patel: Cost & safety controls: set up budgets with alerts at 50/75/90%; deny instance types via SCP/service control or IAM conditions for non-prod. Consider reserved/dedicated host discussions if steady-state sustained. Also tag naming: `project:hera team:inference env:prod cost-center:AI-22`

jordan lee: Timeline expectations: GCP small increases often 1-3 days if justification + billing are in order; AWS depends on support plan — business/enterprise faster; Azure 7-10 days typical. If you need expedited, include support SLA and attach architecture diagram.

alex c: Perfect — action items: Mira will open GCP + AWS quota requests, Samir will draft network/shared VPC, Jordan will prepare the ticket template and Azure request. I'll add budgets and tag schema to runbook.

mira chen: On it, I'll post the case numbers back here when opened. Using tag `project:hera team:inference env:prod` for all resources.

alex c: Thanks all :thumbsup: Ping here once cases are live and when we have approval windows.
